import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_4.csv"
]

# Columns of the target table (same as source tables)
target_columns = ['Module', 'Time', 'Date', 'Room', 'Room_Capacity', 'Registered_Students']

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns order matches target columns order
    # Source columns: ['Time', 'Date', 'Room', 'Room_Capacity', 'Module', 'Registered_Students']
    # Target columns: ['Module', 'Time', 'Date', 'Room', 'Room_Capacity', 'Registered_Students']
    # Reorder columns accordingly
    df = df[['Module', 'Time', 'Date', 'Room', 'Room_Capacity', 'Registered_Students']]
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (UNION operation)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Export the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Union all source tables (concatenate rows)
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# Drop rows where all columns are NaN (clean empty rows)
df = df.dropna(how='all')

# Group by all non-aggregated columns (leftmost columns in target schema that are string or int)
# Target schema: [Module, Time, Date, Room, Room_Capacity, Registered_Students]
# Group by all except Registered_Students, aggregate Registered_Students by sum
result = df.groupby(['Module', 'Time', 'Date', 'Room', 'Room_Capacity'], dropna=False, as_index=False).agg({'Registered_Students':'sum'})

# Write the final output with exact target column order and names
result = result[['Module', 'Time', 'Date', 'Room', 'Room_Capacity', 'Registered_Students']]

result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
